verdict: Caution: lend selectively to Neemrana electrical-equipment and pump/motor makers with export or rail-linked order books and tight working-capital control; avoid domestic-only, receivables-heavy units until Rajasthan demand signals improve.
title: Neemrana Electrical Equipment, Pumps & Motors: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
## What this business physically is
**These units wind copper into stators, cast and machine housings, assemble pumps and motors, and sell into irrigation, construction, railways and export OEMs.** Cash turns on copper and steel bought weeks ahead, conversion at the plant, then a receivable tail from institutional and government buyers. **Value sits in the order book and the certification (BIS, export approvals), not the machine shop** — so pricing power belongs to those with approved vendor status, and evaporates for job-work units. ## What has changed now
**The national demand signal is strong but the local one is not.** India-wide IIP for NIC 27 electrical equipment is +30.9% YoY and +28.5% Apr-to-date [D], yet Rajasthan GST collections are -4.7% Apr-to-date against India +6.1%, and state electricity demand is +4.0% against India +9.5% [D]. **So when a proposal lands, check the customer mix first; if more than half the order book is Rajasthan state or local government, ask for the receivable ageing and the last three years' collection days.**

## Where the growth is
**Pursue export-linked and rail/infrastructure-linked component makers.** Pitti Engineering's management pointed to railways, wind power, specialty motors and off-highway equipment as the valuable complex applications [4]. The approved 191-km Delhi-Rewari-Jaipur line via Neemrana is expected to cut Delhi-Jaipur travel time by 1-1.5 hours and give Neemrana units a cheaper, faster raw-material route [2] — that is a medium-term logistics gain, not a 2026 cash event. **Avoid pure domestic irrigation-pump assemblers and single-customer job workers** until Rajasthan's GST and power-demand gap closes [D]. ## How to grow safely
**Structure for the working-capital cycle, because this industry eats cash.** One rated peer carried net working capital intensity that ICRA flagged as high [8], and another added roughly ₹600 crore of incremental working capital over three years alongside ₹780 crore of capex [9]. **Price for copper volatility with a quarterly review clause.**

## Early warning signs
**Watch the gap between revenue growth and PAT** — that is exactly the Shakti Pumps pattern [5][7]. Neemrana-specific published data is thin; lean on these first principles and peer behaviour.
watch: GST turnover falls below bank credits for two quarters -> re-rate the limit and seek explanation
Raw-material cost rises faster than selling price for two quarters -> reprice or reduce exposure
Rajasthan government share crosses half the order book -> require escrow or reduce tenor
State GST stays negative vs India for two more quarters -> stop new sanctions in domestic-only units
